cards.title: Spoon Ferry Last Lunchbox Bell
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for a fictional lunchbox harbor tale where the last choice closes the paper trip: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place this ending card after the draft and invite one gentle pretend choice, not any narrow real-world fact: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: choose what the spoon ferry helper does before the lunchbox harbor quiets: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: The helper can ring the tiny bell, return the crumb flag, or wave from the napkin pier; I choose ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling clue: after the choice, the harbor feels ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back one pretend object from earlier, such as the spoon flag or button buoy: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo clue: repeat one harbor word from the beginning in a new way: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the last sentence with the ferry, bell, or quiet water: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: change one plain action into a clearer ending choice: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: circle one object and fill only this ending blank: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-away line: a final choice can close a pretend ferry story: ____________________.

cards.title: Acorn Errand Desk Return Slip
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for a fictional acorn errand tale that finishes by bringing back one small paper clue: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set this card beside the last paragraph and ask which invented errand object should come back: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: pick one acorn office object from the story and use it to close the ending: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: decide whether the helper files, folds, or carries the final errand slip: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling clue: show how the helper feels when the errand desk finally makes sense: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back a walnut tag, leaf stamp, pebble bell, or invented desk slip: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo clue: reuse one word from the opening errand mix-up: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write a closing sentence that names the returned object: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: replace a vague finish with one object that proves the errand is done: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: draw the object first, then name it here: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-away line: an object from earlier can make a small ending feel complete: ____________________.

cards.title: Seed Map Last Drawer Question
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for a fictional seed map room tale that closes by answering or echoing one gentle question: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: invite the writer to find one pretend question from the draft and echo it with invented seed-library words: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: write an ending that points back to one question from the map room: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: decide whether the seed keeper closes the drawer, opens a new map, or leaves a clue card: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling clue: choose the ending feeling after the map question changes: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back one seed bead, folded map, drawer label, or paper key: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo clue: repeat the map-room question with one changed word: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the last sentence so the echoed question feels settled or curious: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: add one earlier map clue so the question echo connects: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: copy the question mark, then fill one answer word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-away line: an ending can echo a question without explaining everything: ____________________.

cards.title: Rain Gauge Railway Tomorrow Ticket
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for a fictional rain railway tale that finishes with a small hint about the next made-up day: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: ask for one paper ticket, gauge mark, or platform clue that hints at what could happen later: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: end the railway story with one quiet clue that could lead to another pretend ride: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: decide whether the train pauses, turns back, or follows a new puddle signal: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling clue: show whether the platform feels calm, curious, bright, or rain-soft at the end: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back a blue ticket, tilted gauge, brass bell, or bead of rain: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo clue: reuse one railway sound from the beginning: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write the last sentence with tomorrow's pretend ticket clue: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: add one small future hint without adding a whole new scene: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: mark one gauge line and write only the hint word: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-away line: a next-day hint can leave the railway tale open but finished: ____________________.

cards.title: Moss Observatory Final Glow
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline backpack ending card for a fictional moss observatory tale that closes with one clear picture: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: invite one invented image from the moss signals, sky chart, or lookout shelf to close the story: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Kid: write the ending so the reader can picture the last quiet observatory moment: ____________________.
cards.endingChoicePrompt: Ending choice: decide whether the observer leaves the moss dial glowing, folded, or turned toward the sky: ____________________.
cards.feelingPrompt: Feeling clue: name the final feeling the closing image should carry: ____________________.
cards.objectReturnPrompt: Object return: bring back a moss dial, pebble lens, folded sky chart, or lantern note: ____________________.
cards.echoPrompt: Echo clue: reuse one moss message word from earlier in the story: ____________________.
cards.finalLinePrompt: Final line: write a closing image with light, moss, stone, or sky: ____________________.
cards.reviseEndingPrompt: Revise ending: replace an explanation with one picture the reader can see: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: sketch the final image, then write two words for it: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-away line: one clear final picture can close a pretend observatory story: ____________________.
